author: Praxis I
title: Dual-BRBG-Adapt-Fused: Two-View Equal-Quota Graph (k=48)
abstract: Dual BRBG with equal-quotas balanced kNN built from fused per-batch distances d_fused=min(d_corr, d_emb) using both residualized PCs (graph view) and ComBat PCA64 (embedding view). Goal: retain ARI/NMI gains without sacrificing mixing (kBET/iLISI).
